item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 04/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of southern China will be gradually replaced by a warm and humid southerly airstream today. Visibility will be rather low over the region in the morning and at night. A cold front is expected to develop over southern China, and move across the coast of Guangdong between Thursday night and Friday morning. There will be showers and a few thunderstorms over the region. Temperatures will fall slightly. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather will be windy and brighter over the coastal areas of Guangdong during the weekend.
